status: Four actual Minecraft cases and reviewed integrated-client check passed.
interaction: Original configurable C modifier plus normal right-click consumes one supported block in survival. Creative placement is free. First real player break removes only the cover and refunds exactly one block in survival; internal components and their live circuit remain. Ordinary adjacent block placement remains available without C.
state: Independent raw cover block-state/item NBT retains block properties and exact item metadata through node reload. Immutable covered/opacity block state gives collision and light queries safe access without worker-thread block-entity reads. Cover emission joins actual component light. Logs retain axis; glass retains transparency; biome-tinted leaves use real block colors. Drawn parts remain inside transparent covers.
protection: Actual Forge placement cancellation, interaction restrictions, loaded entity identity, survival consumption and creative no-drop rules checked. Unknown-mod cover data survives with a stone visual fallback; survival peeling cannot silently destroy an unavailable item.
limits: Only full collision-cube block models are accepted. Block entities, fluids and partial collision shapes are excluded. No arbitrary external block behavior is executed inside a cover.
clientChecks: actual survival right-click and one-block consumption
live 50 V circuit under opaque cover
actual client mining peels only cover
exact inventory plus dropped item count
log axis, glass, leaf tint and glowstone models
otherPersistenceRegression: Actual wrench pickup and replacement preserves the preview legacy four-pin signal mode and configured 3.25 V value.

finalRegression.scope: All required cases passed. Existing per-device focused/client evidence and its limits remain authoritative; this field does not claim every configuration was exercised.
